notes.title: Mirth Melody Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44071383/f62c49d4c50b3ccbe1b952134154ff8ef870c762.jpg[/img]

We are super excited to announce the upcoming release of our new rhythm game: [b]Mirth Melody[/b]!

[b]Mirth Melody[/b] is a small rhythm game set in the Mirth Island universe. In this game, you play as Dodo the duck, exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music.

Add Mirth Melody to your wishlist today! The game will be available in July!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721960/Mirth_Melody/]Wishlist Mirth Melody on Steam[/url]

Thank you for your support!

- Clay Game Studio

notes.title: A New Updated Trailer
notes.content:
Howdy, Mirth folk!

Wow, it's been two weeks since we dropped our latest trailer. The video shows you some new areas, new characters, and new gameplay!  Did you catch it? If not, don't worry, we've got you covered—check it out here:
[previewyoutube=4ud2TaUVVWA;full][/previewyoutube]
The response has been amazing, and there's been a surge of playtest requests not long after the trailer release. And let me tell you, if you're wondering why the demo/playtest version looks a bit different from what you saw in the trailer, well, the game has improved a lot! We've improved the graphics, expanded the areas, added new characters, and many more!

We're so thrilled to tell you that a new demo is coming. In the meantime, plese follow and interact with our [url=https://twitter.com/MirthIslandGame/]Twitter[/url] (X, ugh) for the latest news.

See you again soon!

Cheers,
Clay Game Studio
